prompt: Ray paints the fence bright yellow
title: Yellow Fence Today
irony: Ray paints the fence bright yellow to sell the house next year, but the sunny mess keeps friends playing outside today, so the for-sale fence becomes the stay-and-play fence.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun hits the grey fence outside Ray's house while yellow paint cans shine by the gate.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy, Hattie and Ray face the grey fence as Ray dreams of next year and Teddy clutches paint facts.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Constance marches over with her rule book and warns the bright yellow breaks street rules by supper.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew grabs rollers and sings while the first bright yellow strokes flash across the grey boards.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Hattie slaps paint fast while Teddy freezes, drips run down the boards and Ray checks his ringing phone.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Yellow handprints dot Teddy, Hattie and the gate, and Constance gasps at the polka-dot mess.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew grabs rollers and sings while the bright yellow paint spreads wider down the street fence.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Ray stands by the half-yellow fence and admits he paints for next year and misses today.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Ray pockets his phone and asks the kids to finish the bright fence together today.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crew sings by the fence as Ray hugs Hattie and they brush the last yellow board together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The crew sings by the finished yellow fence with handprints as neighbors stop and smile in the sun.
